name: Cloud Pancake with Raspberries & Salted Butter
description: Fluffy protein-packed soufflé-style pancake with a creamy centre, crisp salted butter top, and sharp raspberries for balance.

ingredients.name: Oats
ingredients.notes: light weekday version; double for weekend

ingredients.name: Salted French butter
ingredients.notes: for cooking; doubles as flavour enhancer

ingredients.name: Raspberries
ingredients.notes: fresh or frozen, dropped straight into the pan

instructions: Whip the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Whisk yolks with protein powder, oat milk, and oats until smooth.
Fold yolk mixture gently into the whipped whites to keep volume.
Melt butter in a non-stick pan over low heat.
Pour in the batter, drop raspberries into the mix, and cook until the base is golden.
Flip into a bowl so the crispy salted butter base becomes the top. Spoon in while centre is still creamy.
our_changes: Cut oats to 8g and butter to 5g for a lean weekday version.
Weekend upgrade: 15g oats and 10g butter for a ~450 kcal indulgence.
Optional extra: 10g grated dark chocolate for a dessert twist.
notes: Whipped whites make this insanely light and fluffy. Best eaten immediately while the centre is still creamy.
